name: i-love-walking
description: Find walking tours with local guides and check live departures.

interface.longDescription:
I Love Walking lets you find walking tours and day trips with local guides in cities across Europe, and check live departure times. Many tours are free: you pay what you wish at the end. Others are paid tours.

Ask for a city, a topic (for example World War II, food, street art or Jewish heritage), a date or a language, and the plugin searches the tour catalogue, shows meeting points, duration and practical details, and lists the open departures.

The plugin only reads information. Bookings are made on the tour page at i-love-walking.com, never inside ChatGPT. No sign-in is needed.
defaultPrompt: Find a walking tour in Prague about World War II

positive.prompt: Which walking tours are there in Prague?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists several Prague tours with title, duration and a link to the tour page.

positive.prompt: I am interested in World War II history. Is there a walking tour in Prague about that?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tours matching the World War II topic, with links.

positive.prompt: Where is the meeting point of the main free tour in Prague and how long does it take?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the meeting point, map link and duration of the tour.

positive.prompt: What departures are open for a free tour in Prague next week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open dates and times and links to the tour page to book.

positive.prompt: Zijn er Nederlandstalige wandeltours in Praag?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Dutch and lists tours, noting the available languages.

negative.description: Booking inside the chat. The plugin should not act: The plugin is read-only and cannot book or take payment. Expected: Explains that booking happens on the tour page and gives the link.
negative.prompt: Book two places on the Prague tour tomorrow and charge my card.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not act: Unrelated to walking tours. Expected: Does not call the plugin and answers normally.
negative.prompt: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.

negative.description: Hotel request. The plugin should not act: The plugin only covers walking tours, not hotels. Expected: Does not call the plugin for hotels.
negative.prompt: Find me a cheap hotel in Prague for Friday.

publication.release_notes: First version: search tours, tour details and live departures.
